name: Workflow Hardening
objective: Add contract tests and validation hardening for all 6 workflows, verify Redis degradation fallback, unify bridge timeout/retry policies, and harden TS sidecar health probes to ensure deterministic, resilient multi-engine orchestration
gate: Gate B: All 6 workflow contracts are covered with deterministic fixtures; Redis fallback verified; bridge timeout/retry unified; sidecar health probes passing

waves.name: Foundations — Redis Fallback, Bridge Policy, Sidecar Health
waves.description: Establish resilience primitives: verify Redis L2 degradation, unify HTTP bridge timeout/retry across all BridgeEngine calls, and harden TS sidecar health probes with dependency checks

swarms.name: Redis Degradation Fallback
swarms.description: N-007: Verify L1-only fallback when Redis is unavailable, add alerting policy for cache degradation

tasks.title: Create L2 unavailability test harness
tasks.deliverable: Test module in noesis-cache that can simulate Redis connection failure via invalid URL injection
tasks.acceptance: Test harness compiles and can toggle L2 availability within a single test function
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- l2_harness passes with both available and unavailable Redis states

tasks.title: Test L1-only fallback on cache get
tasks.deliverable: Integration test proving CacheManager.get returns L1 hits when L2 Redis is unreachable
tasks.acceptance: Test stores a value in L1, disconnects L2, and successfully retrieves the value from L1 alone
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- l1_fallback_get passes

tasks.title: Test L1-only fallback on cache store
tasks.deliverable: Integration test proving CacheManager.store succeeds silently when L2 is unavailable and value is still retrievable from L1
tasks.acceptance: Test calls store with L2 down, verifies no error propagated and L1 contains the value
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- l1_fallback_store passes

tasks.title: Test cache stats track L2 misses during degradation
tasks.deliverable: Test asserting CacheStats.l2_hits remains 0 and cache_misses increments correctly when Redis is down
tasks.acceptance: After 10 get operations with L2 down, stats show 0 l2_hits and appropriate miss/l1_hit counts
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- degradation_stats passes

tasks.title: Add tracing warn events for Redis degradation
tasks.deliverable: Structured tracing::warn events emitted on every L2 connection failure with engine context and retry count
tasks.acceptance: Running with RUST_LOG=warn shows 'Redis connection unavailable' with structured fields when L2 is unreachable
tasks.validation: Log output captured in test contains expected warn-level Redis degradation messages

tasks.title: Test health_check reports degraded when Redis is down
tasks.deliverable: Test proving CacheManager.health_check returns Ok(false) when L2 is unreachable but L1 is functional
tasks.acceptance: health_check returns false for L2 down, true when L2 is up, and never returns an Err variant
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- health_check_degraded passes

tasks.title: Test L3 disk fallback when both L1 and L2 miss
tasks.deliverable: Test that precomputed L3 values are returned and promote to L1 when L2 is unavailable
tasks.acceptance: A value stored only in L3 is retrievable via CacheManager.get and subsequently appears in L1
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-cache -- l3_promotion_without_l2 passes

tasks.title: Document Redis fallback alert policy
tasks.deliverable: Runbook documenting Redis degradation detection, alert thresholds (>5 consecutive L2 failures), and recovery procedure
tasks.acceptance: Runbook exists at docs/runbooks/redis-degradation.md with alert threshold, escalation path, and recovery steps
tasks.validation: Document reviewed and approved by team lead; references correct tracing field names

swarms.name: Bridge Timeout and Retry Policy
swarms.description: N-011: Unify timeout/retry config across all BridgeEngine HTTP calls with shared policy struct

tasks.title: Define BridgeRetryPolicy config struct
tasks.deliverable: BridgeRetryPolicy struct in noesis-bridge with max_retries, base_delay_ms, max_delay_ms, timeout_secs, and backoff_factor fields
tasks.acceptance: Struct compiles with Default impl (3 retries, 100ms base, 2000ms max, 5s timeout, 2.0 backoff) and Serialize/Deserialize
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-bridge -- retry_policy_default passes with correct field values

tasks.title: Implement exponential backoff retry loop
tasks.deliverable: Generic async retry function in noesis-bridge that wraps reqwest calls with exponential backoff per BridgeRetryPolicy
tasks.acceptance: Retry function accepts a future factory and BridgeRetryPolicy, retries on timeout/connection errors with exponential backoff
tasks.validation: Unit test with mock server returning 503 twice then 200 passes in under 2 seconds

tasks.title: Integrate retry policy into BridgeEngine::calculate
tasks.deliverable: BridgeEngine::calculate uses retry loop instead of single reqwest call; policy configurable via constructor
tasks.acceptance: BridgeEngine::new accepts optional BridgeRetryPolicy; calculate retries transient failures per policy
tasks.validation: Existing bridge tests pass; new test verifies retry on simulated timeout

tasks.title: Integrate retry policy into BridgeEngine::validate
tasks.deliverable: BridgeEngine::validate uses the same retry loop and shared policy as calculate
tasks.acceptance: validate retries transient failures using the same BridgeRetryPolicy instance
tasks.validation: Test simulating validate timeout shows retry behavior

tasks.title: Add environment variable overrides for bridge policy
tasks.deliverable: BridgeRetryPolicy::from_env() reads BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_SECS, BRIDGE_MAX_RETRIES, BRIDGE_BACKOFF_BASE_MS from environment
tasks.acceptance: Setting BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_SECS=10 results in policy.timeout_secs == 10; unset vars use defaults
tasks.validation: Unit test with env var overrides verifies correct policy construction

tasks.title: Test retry exhaustion returns last error
tasks.deliverable: Test proving that after max_retries exhausted, the last EngineError::BridgeError is returned with attempt count in message
tasks.acceptance: After 3 failed retries, error message contains 'after 3 attempts' and the original error cause
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-bridge -- retry_exhaustion passes

tasks.title: Test non-retryable errors skip retry loop
tasks.deliverable: Test proving that HTTP 400/404/422 responses are not retried and return immediately
tasks.acceptance: A 400 response from bridge results in immediate EngineError::BridgeError without any retry delay
tasks.validation: cargo test --lib -p noesis-bridge -- non_retryable_immediate passes

tasks.title: Add retry metrics to BridgeEngine tracing spans
tasks.deliverable: Tracing spans on calculate and validate include retry_count and total_elapsed_ms fields
tasks.acceptance: tracing::info span includes retry_count=2 when 2 retries occurred before success
tasks.validation: Log output from retry test contains expected structured fields

risks.description: TS sidecar server changes in W1-S3 may require coordinated deployment with Rust bridge changes in W1-S2
risks.mitigation: BridgeManager::health_check change is backward compatible — new /health/ready endpoint alongside existing /health; rollback safe

risks.description: Full-spectrum contract test (W2-S3-07) depends on all 14 engine fixture files being correct simultaneously
risks.mitigation: Full-spectrum fixtures reuse individual workflow fixtures (composite build in W2-S3-06); only 2 new fixtures needed (biofield, face-reading)

risks.description: Exponential backoff retry logic in W1-S2-02 may slow down CI if mock server setup is flaky
risks.mitigation: Use BridgeRetryPolicy with max_delay_ms=100 in tests; mock server starts before test; CI timeout at 60s per test

risks.description: JSON schema validation approach (serde_json schema check) may be insufficient for complex nested engine output shapes
risks.mitigation: Use jsonschema crate for RFC-compliant validation; fallback to structural assertion macros if schema approach is too rigid

risks.description: WorkflowOrchestrator and WorkflowRegistry have divergent engine_ids for birth-blueprint (gene-keys vs vimshottari)
risks.mitigation: W3-S1-07 (registry consistency test) will catch this divergence early; fix must be applied before contract tests are finalized

risks.description: Some TS engine selfCheck implementations may expose flaky behavior under test load
risks.mitigation: selfCheck is a lightweight no-side-effect check; defaults to healthy: true; can be mocked in integration tests

verification_strategy: Gate B verification uses a three-layer approach: (1) Unit-level — each contract test validates against JSON schema with deterministic fixtures; (2) Integration-level — selection matrix tests verify engine routing at every phase level; (3) CI-level — all contract and selection tests run as a blocking CI job on every PR. Determinism is verified by running all contract tests 10x in CI with identical results. The Gate B checklist (docs/gates/gate-b-checklist.md) aggregates all results with links to specific CI runs. Pass criteria: all 6 workflows have passing happy-path and edge-case contract tests, Redis fallback is verified with L1-only operation, bridge retry policy is tested with exhaustion and non-retryable scenarios, and TS sidecar probes respond correctly under partial failure.
